Jwt._comment: SecretKey is intentionally NOT set here. Configure it via the Jwt__SecretKey environment variable or user secrets (>= 32 bytes). Outside Development the app refuses to start without it; in Development a random per-run key is generated. Never commit a real secret to this file.

Auth._comment: Users is empty by default: token issuance returns 501 AUTH_NOT_CONFIGURED until you add users. Generate a PasswordHash with: printf 'your-password' | dotnet run --project src/Loco.Cli -- hash-password
